angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 67,691,610 km at 4134.10 pc = 0.22 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VZ Pup: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4134.1 +/- 98.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 4134.1 +/- 98.2 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2011 +/- 0.0147 mas (same row, RUWE 1.24), 13.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 97.3 +/- 2.3 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VZ Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 97.3 +/- 2.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 67,691,610 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 258, Name='VZ Pup', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 258, Name='VZ Pup', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.24 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 7 published values span log g 0.06 to 2.2, across which the limb law changes by at most 2.7% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...690A.246T)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* VZ Pup: spectral type F7.5
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* VZ Pup: main object type cC*, Classical Cepheid Variable

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
